metadata.question: Does the ice coverage of the Great Lakes decrease from February 20, 2021 to March 3, 2021?

data.raw_code: The user is asking about ice coverage changes in the Great Lakes between February 20, 2021 and March 3, 2021. For this analysis, I need to: 1. Use MODIS or VIIRS snow/ice products that can detect lake ice 2. Define the Great Lakes region geometry 3. Get data for both dates and calculate ice coverage 4. Compare the values to see if there was a decrease For ice detection on lakes, I should use: - MODIS Terra Snow Cover (MOD10A1) or MODIS Aqua Snow Cover (MYD10A1) - Use the NDSI (Normalized Difference Snow Index) or snow cover band - The NDSI_Snow_Cover band provides percentage snow/ice cover I need to: 1. Define Great Lakes polygon 2. Get MODIS data for both dates 3. Calculate mean snow/ice coverage for each date 4. Compare the values 5. Check for data availability and valid pixels I'll use MODIS Terra (MOD10A1) which has daily snow cover data and is reliable for this time period. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const greatLakes = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [-92.0, 46.0], [-92.0, 41.0], [-76.0, 41.0], [-76.0, 46.0], [-92.0, 46.0] ]); const date1 = '2021-02-20'; const date2 = '2021-03-03'; // 2. Data Acquisition - MODIS Terra Snow Cover const modisCol1 = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD10A1') .filterDate(date1, ee.Date(date1).advance(1, 'day')) .filterBounds(greatLakes); const modisCol2 = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD10A1') .filterDate(date2, ee.Date(date2).advance(1, 'day')) .filterBounds(greatLakes); // Check collection sizes const size1 = modisCol1.size().getInfo(); const size2 = modisCol2.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Feb 20 Images: ${size1}, Mar 03 Images: ${size2}`); if (size1 === 0 || size2 === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // Get first image from each collection const img1 = modisCol1.first(); const img2 = modisCol2.first(); // Use NDSI_Snow_Cover band (0-100% snow/ice cover) const band = 'NDSI_Snow_Cover'; // 3. Calculate mean ice coverage for each date const mean1 = img1.select(band).reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: greatLakes, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get(band); const mean2 = img2.select(band).reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: greatLakes, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get(band); // Get pixel counts to check for valid data const count1 = img1.select(band).reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: greatLakes, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get(band); const count2 = img2.select(band).reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: greatLakes, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get(band); // Get all values const [val1, val2, cnt1, cnt2] = await Promise.all([ mean1.getInfo(), mean2.getInfo(), count1.getInfo(), count2.getInfo() ]); console.log(`Feb 20 Ice: ${val1 !== null ? val1.toFixed(2) : 'null'}%, Pixels: ${cnt1}`); console.log(`Mar 03 Ice: ${val2 !== null ? val2.toFixed(2) : 'null'}%, Pixels: ${cnt2}`); // 4. Validation & Final Answer if (cnt1 === 0 || cnt2 === 0) { console.log("C2"); return; } if (val1 === null || val2 === null || isNaN(val1) || isNaN(val2)) { console.log("C3"); return; } // Check if ice coverage decreased if (val2 < val1) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
